digest.component_or_area: MCP gate resolvers (config.py, mcp_server.py, error handling)
propositions: MCP gate resolvers mcp_readonly() and mcp_gate() collapse ConfigError into default bool values instead of raising, violating operator ruling that unreadable config must error
The fail keyword parameter on config.mcp_gate() exists only to provide a fallback value for malformed config and should be removed
MCP error envelope and error_code_for() lack support for ConfigError and config_unreadable vocabulary code, preventing structured error surface to callers
Readable config resolution for mcp_readonly() and mcp_gate() must remain byte-identical (file key honored, env wins) after changing the error path
Documentation (config.md, mcp-reference.md, event-schema.md) must reflect the new contract that unreadable config raises error, not silently resolves gates
